questions.question: The minimum test that proves a quadrilateral is a parallelogram is:
options: One pair of opposite sides both equal AND parallel

questions.question: A rhombus adds which property to the parallelogram's list?
options: Only one pair of parallel sides
Four equal sides, forcing perpendicular diagonals

questions.question: In a triangle, the segment joining the midpoints of two sides is:
options: Parallel to the third side and half its length

questions.question: For the data 5; 7; 8; 10; 12; 15; 20, the mean and median are:
For 5; 7; 8; 10; 12; 15; 20, the lower and upper quartiles are:
The interquartile range measures:
options: The average distance from the mean
The width of the corridor holding the middle half of the data

questions.question: One wildly large value affects:
options: The median strongly, the mean barely
Neither the mean nor the median
The mean strongly; the median barely, since it depends on position not size

questions.question: In the family tree picture, a square is:
options: A child of both the rectangle and the rhombus, inheriting all their properties

questions.question: The 'ticket price' proof strategy means:
options: Proving every property of the shape
Proving only the minimum property; inheritance supplies the rest
Measuring the sides with a ruler
Assuming the shape from the diagram

questions.question: The word 'midpoint' appearing twice in a triangle question signals:
options: The midpoint theorem or its converse

questions.question: Adding the Maths count to the Science count counts learners taking both:
options: Twice — which is why the overlap is subtracted once
It depends on the class size

questions.question: The golden rule for filling a Venn diagram is:
options: Fill the overlap first, then work outwards

questions.question: Relative frequency and theoretical probability:
options: Drift together as the number of trials grows
Are both computed before the experiment

questions.question: Complementary events are stronger than mutually exclusive because they:
options: Cannot happen together AND leave nothing uncovered

options: Leans right — dragged by larger values

questions.question: A Venn diagram's regions summing to 43 in a class of 40 means:
options: An error — the overlap was almost certainly counted twice

questions.question: For skewed data with extreme values, the more honest measure of centre is:
options: The median — it depends on position, not size
